data.one_liner: Include dynamic web-hosted fonts or custom fonts in your Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to load custom or web-hosted fonts dynamically at runtime via HTTP and cache them in the app's file system. It provides an API similar to google_fonts, supporting custom fonts hosted anywhere with checksum verification.
use_when: Your app offers users multiple choices of fonts and you want to keep the initial download slim
You want to use arbitrary fonts not found on Google Fonts via a dynamic loading mechanism
avoid_when: You only use a fixed set of fonts that can be normally bundled in your app assets
You want standard Google Fonts (use the official google_fonts package instead)
strengths: Reduces initial app bundle size by loading fonts on demand
Supports automatic fallback to pre-bundled local assets if files match
Allows security validation via SHA256 checksums and file lengths
weaknesses: Requires runtime HTTP fetching unless pre-bundled or pre-loaded
Requires manual font registration and cryptographic verification setup
data.setup_notes: Register fonts using DynamicFonts.register and optionally bundle fallback files in your pubspec assets.

alternatives.name: google_fonts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick google_fonts if you specifically want to load Google Fonts instead of arbitrary custom-hosted fonts.
